## Introduction

This chapter introduces the Fossilized Birth-Death (FBD) process using forward simulations.

At the end of the chapter you will be able to

-   describe the biological and geological processes that are part of the FBD model
-   Be familiar with the different paramterisations of the model
-   Understand the difference between the complete and the sampled tree
